# BootsGuide

> BootsGuide is an independent UK-focused publication providing evidence-led boot reviews, side-by-side comparisons and practical buying and ownership guides.

BootsGuide is written in British English for UK shoppers. The first complete editorial hub covers Blundstone boots, including models 500, 550 and 585. Articles distinguish verified manufacturer specifications from editorial interpretation and do not claim hands-on testing unless it is explicitly stated. Product details, stock and retailer listings may change, so readers and agents should use the fact-check date shown on each article and verify time-sensitive information with the manufacturer or retailer.

Some product links are paid affiliate links. Affiliate relationships do not determine editorial conclusions. See the affiliate disclosure for details.

## Start here

- [BootsGuide home](https://bootsguide.co.uk/): Overview of the publication and its main content areas.
- [Brands directory](https://bootsguide.co.uk/brands/): Current and planned brand hubs.
- [Blundstone hub](https://bootsguide.co.uk/brands/blundstone/): Complete index of published Blundstone reviews, comparisons and guides.

## Model reviews

- [Blundstone 500 review](https://bootsguide.co.uk/reviews/blundstone-500/): Original-series fit, break-in, materials, weather use, durability and value.
- [Blundstone 550 review](https://bootsguide.co.uk/reviews/blundstone-550/): Smooth full-grain leather, Classic-series comfort, fit and alternatives.
- [Blundstone 585 review](https://bootsguide.co.uk/reviews/blundstone-585/): Rustic Brown waxed nubuck, Classic-series fit, comfort, rain limits and value.

## Comparisons

- [Blundstone 500 vs 585](https://bootsguide.co.uk/comparisons/blundstone-500-vs-585/): Original simplicity compared with lined Classic comfort.
- [Blundstone 550 vs 585](https://bootsguide.co.uk/comparisons/blundstone-550-vs-585/): Smooth full-grain leather compared with rustic waxed nubuck.

## Buying and ownership guides

- [Best Blundstone boots](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/best-blundstone-boots/): Current models matched to use case, fit family and leather preference.
- [Blundstone size guide](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/blundstone-size-guide/): UK sizing, toe room, heel lift and the role of half sizes.
- [Are Blundstones waterproof?](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/are-blundstones-waterproof/): Water resistance, waterproof variants and realistic weather limits.
- [How to clean Blundstone boots](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/how-to-clean-blundstone-boots/): Material-specific care for smooth leather, waxed nubuck, nubuck and suede.
- [Are Blundstones good for walking?](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/are-blundstones-good-for-walking/): Everyday walking use, support and hiking limitations.
- [How long do Blundstones last?](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/how-long-do-blundstones-last/): Service-life factors, care and signs of wear.
- [How to break in Blundstones](https://bootsguide.co.uk/guides/blundstone-break-in/): Gradual break-in and signs that indicate the wrong size.
